voice_mode: prototype_tts_only; final recorded VO is production work

start.text: Someone saw enough to become dangerous. We find them first.

witness-file.text: A witness file this thin means someone wanted it thin.

witness-contact.text: If the contact point is still clean, the witness is scared, not gone.

witness-convince.text: You do not have to trust us. You only have to tell the truth.

complete.text: Now we know what they saw. That changes the board.

start.text: We get them out quiet. No hero stuff, no sirens.

route-clear.text: Keep the route simple. Fewer eyes means fewer problems.

escort-witness.text: Stay close. If anybody asks, you saw absolutely nothing.

safehouse.text: You're safe for now. That's all we can promise.

complete.text: Nobody saw anything. For once, that's exactly what we needed.

start.text: A job without wheels is just a bad idea waiting to happen.

vehicle-source.text: This one has potential. Needs somebody who knows what they're doing.

vehicle-store.text: Keep it maintained. We cannot afford a failure at the wrong time.

complete.text: Workshop has a runner. The city just got smaller.

start.text: You know what ruins a clean job? A tire deciding it has opinions.

damage-check.text: Front tire. We have a problem.

repair-tire.text: Give me a minute. I can fix ugly.

destination.text: Move. We finish the route before anyone notices.

complete.text: Bad tire, worse timing. Still made it.

start.text: Package goes across Central. Fast and boring. That's the dream.

package-secure.text: Clock starts now. Do not improvise unless you have to.

package-deliver.text: Package delivered. See? I can be responsible.

complete.text: The evidence moved. The question is who noticed.

start.text: The driver is the link. Lose them and we lose the chain.

target-identify.text: That's our driver. Same pattern, different vehicle.

tail-start.text: Distance. Let them think the city is empty.

tail-finish.text: We have the route. They never knew we were there.

complete.text: People leave patterns when they think nobody is watching.

start.text: The witness called it in. Now the search is moving.

incident.text: Do not panic. Panic creates witnesses.

search-break.text: Search is splitting. That's our window.

escape.text: Move. We are out of their first net.

complete.text: Now the witness system knows our names.

start.text: Those sirens are definitely for us.

pursuit.text: Keep moving. Do not fight the road.

break-line.text: Lost them. I knew this car had one good idea in it.

safe-location.text: Hold here. Let the city forget where we went.

complete.text: Heat's off. My heart is still filing a complaint.

start.text: Warehouse 7 keeps records people think nobody can find.

warehouse-entry.text: Ledger should be close. Quiet feet.

ledger-secure.text: There. Names, dates, payments. Somebody kept receipts.

warehouse-exit.text: We leave with the ledger, not a body count.

complete.text: Paper can be more dangerous than a weapon.

start.text: Being seen has a price. Tonight we pay part of it.

wanted-lower.text: First, we make the city look somewhere else.

evidence-track.text: Found the trail. Whoever took it did not go far.

evidence-recover.text: Recovered. We control the evidence again.

complete.text: Exposure changes the rules. From here on, every move leaves a shadow.
